sentences.text: Appearance:
Shri Vikas Rathi, learned counsel for the Petitioner .
Shri Chetan Joshi Pl appearing on behalf of Advocate Gen  ORDER Heard and perused the record.
This is the second bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail.
The applicant is arrested in relation to Crime No.5/2024 registered at Police Station-Balakwada City, District Khargone(M.P.), for the offence under Sections 304-B and 498A of IPC.
The applicant is in jail since 08.01.2024.
Earlier, first bail application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn on 25.04.2024 with liberty to renew the prayer after three months.
2. As per prosecution story, the deceased was subjected to cruelty by the present applicant and other co-accused persons for demand of dowry as a result of which she committed suicide.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case.
It is further submitted that earlier, liberty was granted to the applicant to renew the prayer after three months and the said period has already been lapsed.
Only omnibus allegation has been made against the present applicant.
In identical case, the two other co-accused persons, who are mother-in-law and father-in-law of the deceased have been enlarged on bail by this Court.
The 2 MCRC-32695-2024 present applicant is the husband of the deceased.
The applicant is in jail since 08.01.2024.
Final conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.
Under these circumstances, counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
4. On the other hand, learned Panel Lawyer for the State has opposed the prayer and prays for rejection of the bail application.

sentences.text: 5. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, nature of allegation made against the applicant and custody period, I am of the view that it is a fit case, in which applicant may be released on bail.
Consequently, without commenting on the merits of the case, first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
